lines.text: Ar and Kir in Moab are destroyed in a night, and people wail in sackcloth in the streets.
Moab's fugitives flee as far as Zoar, and the people carry their wealth over the Brook of the Willows.
The waters of Dimon are full of blood, and a bear will come upon the fugitives of Moab.
Tribute lambs are to be sent from Sela to the mount of Daughter Zion, and a throne will be established in the tent of Saul.
The LORD says that in three years Moab's splendor will become an object of contempt, and the survivors will be few and feeble.
